name: codex-codeintel
description: Nine compact MCP tools for checks, navigation, context and previewed edits; apply is the only source writer.

interface.shortDescription: Code intelligence and previewed lint/LSP fixes
interface.longDescription: Codex CodeIntel shares local LSP and CLI checks across MCP and optional nonblocking Hooks. Nine tools provide diagnostics, navigation, context and edit previews. Only apply writes source files; plans are single-use. Use setupLSP to configure project tools.
defaultPrompt: Run diagnostics on the files I just edited.
Use inspect to understand the affected symbols and candidate tests.
Preview formatting with format, then apply the plan to the authorized files.
